text_blocks.snippet: Common side effects of losartan include dizziness, tiredness, a stuffy nose, and back pain.
snippet_highlighted_words: dizziness, tiredness, a stuffy nose, and back pain

text_blocks.snippet: Most mild side effects improve as your body gets used to the medication:

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness, especially when standing up quickly
Cold-like symptoms (upper respiratory infections, stuffy nose)
Back or leg pain and muscle cramps
Digestive issues like diarrhea or mild stomach upset

text_blocks.snippet: You can learn more about general usage and descriptions from the Mayo Clinic Losartan Guide.
Some side effects require immediate medical attention:

list.snippet: Allergic reactions (Angioedema): Sudden swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, and trouble breathing
High potassium levels (Hyperkalemia): Muscle weakness, confusion, or an irregular heartbeat
Low blood pressure (Hypotension): Fainting, severe dizziness, or confusion
Kidney problems: Swelling in your feet or hands, or urinating much less than usual
Pregnancy warning: Losartan can cause severe injury or death to an unborn baby and should be stopped immediately if you become pregnant.

text_blocks.snippet: For official patient guidance and safety details, check MedlinePlus Losartan or the NHS Losartan Overview.
If you are experiencing a specific symptom, tell me what you are feeling and how long it has been happening so I can provide more relevant information.
